title: Cloud Users and Groups
scenario: A healthcare organization has already provisioned its Microsoft 365 tenant and activated licensing. The next phase is to establish a pilot cloud identity set in Microsoft Entra ID and Microsoft 365 by creating cloud-only users, organizing them into department-based security groups, enabling both assigned and attribute-driven membership, assigning Microsoft 365 E5 licenses, and validating that selected users can authenticate to Microsoft 365 services.

reference.label: Pilot users
reference.value: Alice Morgan, Brian Patel, Carla Johnson, Daniel Kim, Evelyn Rodriguez

activities.title: Task 1 - Create the First Pilot User
activities.prompt: You want to create the first pilot cloud identity in Microsoft Entra ID by using the values provided in the case study. To answer, move the appropriate actions from the list of actions to the answer area and arrange them in the correct order.
steps: Sign in to Microsoft Entra Admin Center
Select New user → Create new user
Enter Alice Morgan's UPN, display name, job title, and department
Allow Entra to auto-generate the password
answer: Sign in to Microsoft Entra Admin Center
Select New user → Create new user
Enter Alice Morgan's UPN, display name, job title, and department
Allow Entra to auto-generate the password
activities.explanation: The lab starts in All users, creates Alice Morgan first, and requires the identity attributes listed in the pilot-user table.

activities.title: Task 2 - Map the Pilot Users to Departments
activities.prompt: You want to verify that the pilot users were created with the correct department attributes because those values will later drive group membership and validation. To answer, match each pilot user on the left with the correct department on the right.
activities.explanation: The department attribute is central to both manual group placement and dynamic group membership in the lab.

activities.title: Task 3 - Create an Assigned Security Group
activities.prompt: You want to create one of the manually managed departmental security groups in Microsoft Entra ID. To answer, move the appropriate actions from the list of actions to the answer area and arrange them in the correct order.
steps: Choose Security as the group type
Choose Assigned as the membership type
answer: Choose Security as the group type
Choose Assigned as the membership type
activities.explanation: Assigned groups are created manually and use Security + Assigned in the new-group workflow.

activities.title: Task 4 - Build the Dynamic Membership Rule
activities.prompt: You want to create the Clinical Services dynamic group so that user membership is determined automatically from the Department attribute. To answer, select the appropriate value for each blank in the rule statement.
activities.explanation: The lab uses Dynamic User groups and defines membership by department values such as Clinical Services and Finance.

activities.title: Task 5 - Map the Group Membership Model
activities.prompt: You want to distinguish which groups require manual membership updates and which groups populate automatically. To answer, match each group on the left with the correct membership model or expected member on the right.
activities.explanation: The lab uses manual membership for three assigned groups and automatic membership for the two department-driven dynamic groups.

activities.title: Task 6 - Add a User to an Assigned Group
activities.prompt: You want to place Carla Johnson into the Human_Resources_Cloud assigned group. To answer, move the appropriate actions from the list of actions to the answer area and arrange them in the correct order.
activities.explanation: Manual membership changes are performed from the group object by opening Members, adding the user, and saving.

activities.title: Task 7 - Verify License Availability
activities.prompt: You want to confirm that the required cloud license is available before assigning services to the pilot users. To answer, select the navigation path that should be opened in Microsoft 365 Admin Center.
activities.explanation: The license-verification step in the lab occurs before assignment and is performed from the Billing area.

activities.title: Task 8 - Assign Microsoft 365 E5 to a Pilot User
activities.prompt: You want to assign Microsoft 365 E5 to one of the pilot users after verifying license availability. To answer, move the appropriate actions from the list of actions to the answer area and arrange them in the correct order.
activities.explanation: The lab separates license availability from license assignment and performs the assignment from the Active users area.

activities.title: Task 9 - Verify Identity Configuration from the User Profile
activities.prompt: You want to review a pilot user in Microsoft Entra ID and validate both license and group membership. To answer, match each verification area on the left with the information it should confirm on the right.
left: Members tab of an assigned group
right: Assigned and dynamic memberships are visible
Manual group membership was added correctly

answer.Groups tab: Assigned and dynamic memberships are visible
answer.Members tab of an assigned group: Manual group membership was added correctly

activities.explanation: The lab validates identities from multiple views: all users, group membership, and the user profile’s licenses and groups tabs.

activities.title: Task 10 - Complete Sign-In Validation
activities.prompt: You want to confirm that one of the pilot users can authenticate successfully into Microsoft 365 and reach cloud services after account creation and license assignment. To answer, select the action that should occur immediately before validating access to Outlook, OneDrive, Teams, and SharePoint.
options: Complete the first sign-in password reset in a private browser session
Open Active Directory Users and Computers
activities.answer: Complete the first sign-in password reset in a private browser session
activities.explanation: The lab’s sign-in validation uses an InPrivate/Incognito browser session and requires completion of the password reset before cloud services are checked.
